sloka: ऊचुः प्राञ्जलयो देवा महोदरनिभोदराः ।त्वया नु भगवन्सृष्टाः प्रजानाथ चतुर्विधाः ।। ७.३५.५४ ॥
transliteration: ūcuḥ prāñjalayo devā mahodaranibhodarāḥ ।tvayā nu bhagavansṛṣṭāḥ prajānātha caturvidhāḥ ।। 7.35.54 ॥

translations.english: With folded hands, the gods, whose bellies appeared distended from suffering, addressed Prajapati, saying, "O Lord of creatures, indeed, the four kinds of beings were created by you."
